capabilities: Place notes and text blips on a radar
Group blips into category segments and priority rings
Drag notes from the file explorer onto the radar
Color blips automatically from tags or properties
Export the radar as a high-resolution PNG
disambiguation: Not a monitoring or scanning tool; it draws notes as blips on a configurable radar chart.
extras: Radar files are stored as UTF-8 JSON (.radar) so they can be generated or edited by scripts and AI workflows; the full spec is in docs/JSON-radar.md. Mobile app is supported.
motivation: The author built it to answer the question "What's on your radar?" and to avoid losing sight of items that might be hiding good opportunities.
problem: Notes and projects scattered across a vault give no quick sense of what matters most right now or what is drifting out of focus.

relations.evidence: Install and enable the BRAT plugin from the Obsidian community plugins browser

summary: Radar chart view that places notes and text blips on concentric priority rings and category segments.
